title: FBI Captures Alleged Bhagwanpuria Gang Associate Nitish Kaushal in Vermont
description: The FBI announced the capture of Nitish Kaushal, an associate of the Jaggu Bhagwanpuria Organized Crime Group, in Vermont, aided by US Border Patrol. Kaushal is wanted for serious crimes linked to the Bhagwanpuria OCG, a transnational criminal organization.
